about_the_game:
STORY:

Start journey in this medieval third person rpg game and be the hero and beat evil goblins

Green goblin and his army has captured valuable skulls and hidden them. Player warrior mission is to beat goblin and his army. Player fight against different small creatures which have different attacks like punch attack, magic attack, bomb attack etc. End of level player meet big green goblin who are playing drums and making different attacks like hitting and magic attacks. Player need kill boss and then fence or gate will disappear and player can collect skull and finish level. Game contain now 9 different levels. Player can also collect health potions. So be saviour or world and beat green goblin and his army

FEATURES:

  • 9levels
    - RPG Game and player character has big sword weapon
    - different small creature enemies with punch attacks, magic attacks etc
    - Use healing potions to increase health
    - Green goblin boss end of every level. Boss is playing drums and making different magic attacks. Kill boss to destroy fence and collect captured skull to get steam achievement and finish level

    PLANNED UPDATES:
    - more levels
